units.source_text: 町子从嘴唇到足尖，完全听任鹿山的摆布。

en.t: From her lips to the tips of her toes, Machiko completely submitted herself to Kayama's control.

units.source_text: 一句台词或一举手一投足，都按鹿山所教的那样在舞台上再现。

en.t: Every line, every gesture, every movement of her hands and feet was reproduced on stage exactly as Kayama had taught her.

units.source_text: 鹿山说像小姑娘般的害怕，是爱的吝啬。

en.t: Kayama said that being afraid like a little girl was stinginess in love.

units.source_text: 他这么一说，町子就像二十五岁的女人那样大胆地恋爱了。

en.t: Once he said that, Machiko loved boldly, like a woman of twenty-five.

units.source_text: 恐怕不会有比这更高的爱法了。

en.t: There was probably no higher way of loving than this.

units.source_text: 如果说町子的爱法中只有一个错误的话，就是她把新恋情向鹿山坦率地说了出来。

en.t: If there was only one mistake in Machiko's way of loving, it was that she frankly told Kayama about her new romance.
